result_text:
I fixed the three broken default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`. The new test class passes (7 of 7).

- **`.htm` pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator HTML rules now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`. This also removes the duplicated `html`.
- **.NET doc XML:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` content check is unchanged.
- **`// Generated by` JavaScript:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle scripts:** the pattern is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks the files the task names, which should match, and ordinary hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files, which should not. I did not run the test against the old code to confirm it fails there. Nothing is committed.
